metadata.title: fix(#1956): propagate team_id, owner_email and visibility to a2a tool creation
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

When creating tools from A2A agents, the `team_id`, `owner_email`, and `visibility` fields from the agent were not being propagated to the tool registration. This caused:
- A2A agent tools to appear without team association in the admin UI
- Tools to be inaccessible via team-scoped API queries

This fix ensures tools created from A2A agents inherit the same team scoping as the parent agent, consistent with how gateways propagate these fields to their federated tools.

Adds unit test to prevent regression.

Closes #1956
Supersedes #1965

---

**Original contribution by @liutaoibm** - rebased and cleaned up.

Signed-off-by: Jerry Liu <liutao@us.ibm.com>
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

commits.message:
fix(#1956): propagate team_id, owner_email and visibility to a2a tool creation

When creating tools from A2A agents, the team_id, owner_email, and
visibility fields from the agent were not being propagated to the
tool registration. This caused A2A agent tools to appear without team
association in the admin UI, and made them inaccessible via team-scoped
API queries.

This change ensures that tools created from A2A agents inherit the same
team_id, owner_email, and visibility as the parent agent, consistent
with how gateways propagate these fields to their federated tools.

Closes #1956

Signed-off-by: Jerry Liu <liutao@us.ibm.com>
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
